name: @epoch/adapter-fmi
description: Epoch Co-Simulation Participant adapter (W029 reference set) — the typed, provider-neutral reference adapter for co-simulation participant models (simulation category): participant-model fixtures become typed simulation participants with typed ports (inputs/outputs/parameters as declared, value-kinded, unit-carrying ports); a step is a typed, deterministic, content-addressed exchange (identical inputs -> identical step digests; idempotent step replay returns the sealed prior record; different content under the same key is a typed replay-conflict); the participant derives a REAL W005 simulator registration and executes behind the W021 simulation-fabric execution-port seam (compile-time + runtime devDependency parity — the fabric sees only its own typed contracts). Provider vocabulary stays in src/provider (blocklist-tested). In-memory reference behavior: NO network, NO live co-simulation runtimes, NO real side effects; fixtures stand in for provider payloads.
